about: REAL pay ranges from published salary data (MOM wage tables, recruitment salary guides). The AI's typical total pay (base + bonus + equity) for that job and year must fall inside. Every row needs a source link. Rows with min/max = null are ignored until filled in.
how_to_fill: position_index matches career_history in data/sample/case_001.json (0 = Operations Planner 1998-2003 ... 4 = COO 2017-now). Use annual pay in SGD.
